description: A publicly released Universal Dependencies treebank of 20 Old English Cairo sentences with syntactic, morphological, hyperlemma, root, and Modern English gloss annotations, created by Lauren Levine et al.
title: UD Old English Cairo treebank

description: UDAT is an open-source command-line text-analysis tool developed by Lior Shamir that enables novice users to analyze linguistic features, discover patterns, and perform explainable classification and feature-selection analyses without strong programming skills.
title: UDAT
